expenditures.detail: delta +18.00 (rows 586.40 vs stated/printed 568.40). CAUSE IDENTIFIED as FILER ARITHMETIC, not a read error: 586.40 and 568.40 are a DIGIT TRANSPOSITION of one another (86 <-> 68), and the same 568.40 is carried through the filer's own SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE, TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE, Summary Page line 2 Column A and line 6 - i.e. the wrong figure was propagated, which is what a transposition at the adding-machine looks like. Every one of the 8 amounts was re-read at 1200 dpi cell resolution and the two doubtful superscripts (row 1 '.68', row 4 '.18') were each escalated individually; the rows sum to 586.40 with no residual. No row was adjusted and the stated total was not recomputed.

Both figures are recorded verbatim and no row was moved to close the gap - see the expenditures recon detail for the transposition evidence. The three 'Other Campaign Accounts' pages (p5 summary, p6 contributions, p7 expenditures) each print a slashed-zero in every figure cell including their subtotals, so they gate at zero.

itemized.notes: 7-page filing. p1 cover (September 15 interim box checked, Council District 6, Republican), p2 Summary Page, p3 Itemized Contributions Received, p4 Itemized Expenditures Made, then THREE 'Other Campaign Accounts' pages: p5 'Summary Page - Other Campaign Accounts' (a DIFFERENT table from the standard Summary Page, Column B headed 'Year to Date'), p6 'Itemized Contributions from Other Campaign Accounts' and p7 'Itemized Expenditures from Other Campaign Accounts'. p5's lines 1-7 all carry slashed-zero glyphs; p6 is blank with a large hand-drawn X through the grid and a slashed zero in both its subtotal and total cells; p7 is blank with slashed zeros in both. Under the repo zero-glyph ruling those are real ZEROS, so the other-accounts schedules are honestly empty - they are NOT part of the county-account sides transcribed here and none of their (zero) figures were folded into the sums above. This filing's redaction is REAL: the county blacked out the cover's street address block, the phone/fax/email block, and the single contributor's entire mailing address cell; donor_city/donor_state are therefore 'redacted', a different state from a filer leaving them empty. The filing prints as a fax from 'Burdick & Associates' with a Sep 17 12 header band on every page.
